walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE Computer Science specification.

The Internet & Its Uses appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet The Internet & Its Uses in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Internet & Its Uses.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
